# Palo Alto Networks

> Global cybersecurity leader providing solutions for Zero Trust, Network Security, Cloud Workloads, and Threat Intelligence. We protect the digital way of life through disruption, execution, and collaboration.

## Company Overview
- [About Us](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/about-us): Our mission, values, and commitment to protecting the digital way of life.
- [Management Team](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/about-us/management): Executive leadership and management.
- [ESG & Corporate Responsibility](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/about-us/corporate-responsibility): Environmental, social, and governance strategies.
- [Why Palo Alto Networks](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/why-paloaltonetworks): Our differentiation as the cybersecurity partner of choice.
- [Platformization](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/why-paloaltonetworks/platformization): The benefits of a simplified, consolidated security platform.
- [Contact Sales](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/company/contact-sales) : Direct contact information to reach the Palo Alto Networks sales team.
- [Resources & Content Library](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/resources) : Central repository for datasheets, whitepapers, and guides.
- [Customers](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/customers) : Explore case studies and success stories from our global customers.
- [Why Palo Alto Networks](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/why-paloaltonetworks) : Details on our Precision AI technology and platformization approach.

## Cortex - AI-Driven Security Operations
> The leading AI-driven platform for SOC transformation, endpoint protection, and attack surface management.

- [Cortex Platform Overview](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex): Transforming security operations.
- [Cortex XSIAM](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cortex-xsiam): The autonomous SOC platform. Centralizes data and automates incident response.
- [Cortex XDR](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cortex-xdr): Extended Detection and Response for endpoints, network, and cloud.
- [Cortex XSOAR](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cortex-xsoar): Security orchestration, automation, and response.
- [Cortex Xpanse](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cortex-xpanse): Active attack surface management and exposure discovery.
- [Cloud Detection & Response (CDR)](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud-detection-and-response): Visibility and protection across cloud environments.
- [AgentiX](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/agentix): Security for the AI agent workforce.
- [Why Cortex](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/whycortex) : Overview of the single, autonomous AI-driven platform for the modern SOC.
- [Endpoint Detection and Response](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/endpoint-detection-and-response) : AI-powered endpoint security that stops advanced attacks.
- [Managed Threat Hunting](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/managed-threat-hunting) : 24/7 expert-led threat hunting services to uncover hidden threats.
- [Unmanaged Cloud Asset Management](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cortex-xpanse/unmanaged-cloud-asset-management) : Cortex Xpanse module for discovering unknown internet-facing cloud risks.
- [ASM for Third-Party & Supply Chain](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cortex-xpanse/attack-surface-management-for-third-party-and-supply-chain-security) : Attack surface management for acquired companies and suppliers.
- [ASM for Remote Workers](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cortex-xpanse/asm-for-remote-workers) : Protects the extended attack surface generated by remote workframes.
- [Cortex XDR Industry Validation](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cortex-xdr-industry-validation) : Third-party testing results and analyst reports for XDR.
- [Cortex Customer Stories](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/customer-stories) : How organizations reduce MTTR using Cortex.
- [Cortex vs. The Competition](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cortex-vs-the-competition) : Competitive analysis and differentiation of the Cortex platform.
- [Cortex XDR Resource Center](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cortex-xdr-resource-center) : Hub for datasheets, reports, and documentation regarding XDR.
- [SecOps Readiness Report](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/secops-readiness-report) : Industry insights on security operations maturity.
- [Request Cortex Demo](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/request-demo) : Engage with experts for a personalized Cortex showcase.
- [Cortex XDR Hands-on Workshop](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cortex-xdr/hands-on-workshop) : Registration for technical deep-dive workshops.



## Network Security (Strata)
> The Zero Trust Network Security Platform, including Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) and cloud-delivered security services.

- [Network Security Overview](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security): Integrated platform for hardware, software, and SASE.
- [Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW)](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/next-generation-firewall): ML-Powered physical and virtual firewalls.
- [PAN-OS](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/pan-os): The operating system powering our NGFWs.
- [Panorama](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/panorama): Centralized management for firewalls.
- [Strata Cloud Manager](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/strata-cloud-manager): AI-powered management and operations.
- [Advanced WildFire](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/advanced-wildfire): Cloud-based malware prevention engine.
- [Advanced Threat Prevention](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/advanced-threat-prevention): IPS solution blocking zero-day threats inline.
- [IoT/OT Security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/device-security): Securing all devices from IT to IoT and OT.
- [VM-Series Virtual NGFW](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/vm-series-virtual-next-generation-firewall) : Software firewalls securing virtualized and agile cloud environments.
- [Cloud NGFW](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/cloud-ngfw) : Best-in-class network security delivered as a managed cloud service for AWS.
- [Cloud NGFW for Azure](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/cloud-ngfw-for-azure) : Managed next-generation firewall specifically for Microsoft Azure.
- [Protect Your Extended Network](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/protect-your-extended-network) : Strategies to secure assets from data centers to branches and remote sites.
- [Strengthen Your Network Security Foundation](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/strengthen-your-network-security-foundation) : Guides on implementing Zero Trust and inline deep learning.
- [Simplify Network Security Management](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/simplify-network-security-management) : Centralized management through Panorama and Strata Cloud Manager.
- [Data and Cloud Application Security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/data-and-cloud-application-security) : Protecting SaaS applications and preventing data loss.
- [Network Security Customer Stories](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/customer-stories) : Testimonials on preventing successful cyberattacks.
- [Get Started with Network Security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/get-started) : Purchasing paths, deployment guides, and implementation steps.
- [Product Selection](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/products/product-selection) : Interactive guide to finding the right firewalls.


## SASE
> The industry’s most complete SASE solution, converging network security, SD-WAN, and ADEM.

- [Prisma SASE Overview](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/sase): Converged network security and SD-WAN.
- [Prisma Access](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/sase/access): Secure remote access for the hybrid workforce.
- [Prisma SD-WAN](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/sase/sd-wan): Next-generation SD-WAN for branch transformation.
- [Prisma Browser](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/sase/prisma-browser): Secure enterprise browser for managed and unmanaged devices.
- [ADEM](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/sase/adem): Autonomous Digital Experience Management.
- [AI Access Security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/sase/ai-access-security): Safe adoption and governance of GenAI apps.
- [How it Works](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/sase/how-it-works) : The mechanics of discovering, classifying, and protecting SaaS usage and users.
- [Protect Your Sensitive Data](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/sase/protect-your-sensitive-data) : Detailed look at Enterprise DLP and data exposure prevention.
- [Deliver Peak Application Performance](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/sase/deliver-peak-application-performance) : Insights on app acceleration and Autonomous Digital Experience Management (ADEM).
- [SASE Customer Stories](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/sase/customer-stories) : Case studies of successful secure branch transformations.
- [Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/sase/ztna) : Least-privilege access for the hybrid workforce.
- [Secure Web Gateway](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/sase/secure-web-gateway) : Cloud-delivered web security and phishing protection.


## Identity Security
> The next-generation identity security platform that discovers, controls and governs your human and agentic workforce.

- [Idira Overview](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira) : Introduction to the next-generation identity security platform.
- [Human Identities](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human) : Solutions for discovering, controlling, and governing the human workforce.
- [Privileged Access Management](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human/privileged-access-management) : Extends enterprise-grade privileged access controls to every human identity.
- [Identity and Access Management](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human/identity-and-access-management) : Modern MFA and continuous verification for secure workforce access.
- [Endpoint Privilege Manager](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human/endpoint-privilege-manager) : Eliminates standing local admin rights and guards against ransomware.
- [Identity Governance](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human/identity-governance) : Automates least-privileged access and entitlement reviews.
- [Workforce Password Management](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human/workforce-password-management) : Securely vaults, manages, and rotates enterprise credentials.
- [Vendor Privileged Access](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human/vendor-privileged-access) : Secures supply chain access for contractors and third-party vendors.
- [Machine Identities](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/machine) : Discover and protect workload credentials and API keys.
- [Secrets Management](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/machine/secrets-management) : Centralized discovery and visibility across existing vaults and environments.
- [Unified Secrets Governance](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/machine/unified-secrets-governance) : Governance policies for managing machine secrets enterprise-wide.
- [Application Credentials Delivery](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/machine/application-credentials-delivery) : Secure delivery of necessary credentials to applications.
- [Agentic Identities](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/agentic) : New controls and visibility for AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) data access.
- [Idira Customer Stories](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/customer-stories) : Real-world examples of identity security deployments.
- [Request Idira Demo](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/request-demo) : Form to request a hands-on demonstration of Idira.


## Unit 42 - Threat Intelligence & Services
> World-renowned threat researchers, incident responders, and security consultants.

- [Unit 42 Overview](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/unit42): Proactive cyber risk management.
- [Incident Response](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/unit42/respond): Investigation, containment, and remediation.
- [Managed Detection & Response (MDR)](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/managed-detection-and-response): 24/7 monitoring and threat hunting.
- [Assessments](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/unit42/assess): Risk, compromise, and ransomware readiness assessments.
- [Transform Services](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/unit42/transform): vCISO, Zero Trust advisory, and program design.
- [About Unit 42](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/unit42/about) : Introduction to the elite threat intelligence and incident response team.
- [Business Email Compromise](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/unit42/assess/business-email-compromise) : BEC readiness assessments and proactive defense strategies.
- [Threat Intelligence Partners](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/unit42/threat-intelligence-partners) : Alliances to enhance global threat detection.
- [Incident Response Partners](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/unit42/incident-response-partners) : Collaborations ensuring rapid response to active breaches.
- [Unit 42 Customer Stories](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/unit42/customer-stories) : Accounts of how Unit 42 remediated high-stakes breaches.


## Cloud Security (Prisma Cloud)
- [Cloud Security Posture (CSPM)](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/cloud-security-posture-management): Automating identification and remediation of threats.
- [Cloud Workload Protection (CWP)](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/cloud-workload-protection): Securing workloads across environments.
- [Code Security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/code-security): Security across the development lifecycle (IaC).
- [Data Security (DSPM)](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/data-security-posture-management): Discover, classify, and protect sensitive cloud data.
- [Analysts Reports](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/analysts-reports) : Third-party validation of our Cloud Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP).
- [Infrastructure as Code Security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/infrastructure-as-code-security) : Automated security checks embedded in CI/CD developer workflows.
- [Software Composition Analysis](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/software-composition-analysis) : Context-aware open source dependency scanning and OSS license compliance.
- [Secrets Security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/secrets-security) : Multidimensional secrets scanning across repositories and pipelines.
- [AppSec Partner Ecosystem](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/appsec-partner-ecosystem) : Integrations with major developer tools and platforms.
- [Vulnerability Management](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/vulnerability-management) : Continuous monitoring for cloud workload and application vulnerabilities.
- [Attack Surface Management](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/attack-surface-management) : Identifying and securing unknown cloud assets.
- [Kubernetes and Container Security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/kubernetes-and-container-security) : Defense-in-depth protection from code to cloud runtime.
- [API Security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/api-security) : Discovery, posture management, and runtime protection for cloud APIs.
- [Serverless Security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/serverless-security) : Protection for serverless functions against anomalous events.
- [Government Cloud Security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/government) : FedRAMP, StateRAMP, and FIPS 140-2 compliant cloud security solutions.
- [Product Tours](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/product-tours) : Interactive walk-throughs of the Cortex Cloud and Prisma Cloud dashboards.
- [Cloud Security Research](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/research) : In-depth research on cloud vulnerabilities and container threats.
- [Interactive Workshops](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/interactive-workshops) : Hands-on sessions to learn cloud security best practices.
- [Open Source Projects](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/open-source-projects) : Palo Alto Networks' contributions to open-source (Checkov, AirIAM, TerraGoat).
- [Request Demo](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/demo) : Engage with sales for a tailored cloud security demonstration.

## Industry Solutions
- [Financial Services](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/industry/financial-services)
- [Healthcare](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/industry/healthcare)
- [Manufacturing](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/industry/manufacturing)
- [Public Sector](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/industry/public-sector)

## Partners

## Network Security (Strata)

Solutions span physical hardware, software (VM-Series), containerized, and managed cloud services (Cloud NGFW). Cloud-Delivered Security Services integrate seamlessly into these firewalls to provide Advanced Threat Prevention, Advanced URL Filtering, Advanced WildFire, and DNS Security using inline deep learning.

## SASE
> Prisma SASE converges network and security to deliver comprehensive, consistent protection for all users, devices, applications, and data.

Prisma SASE secures the modern hybrid workforce by replacing legacy VPNs and fragmented architectures. It provides true zero trust security with continuous trust verification, offering Cloud Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and Enterprise DLP natively integrated. Prisma SD-WAN enables secure, cloud-delivered branch connectivity, while Autonomous Digital Experience Management (ADEM) ensures peak application performance.

## Identity Security (Idira)
> The next-generation identity security platform designed to discover, control, and govern human, machine, and agentic workforce identities.

Idira closes the access gaps attackers walk through by establishing a continuous motion of discovery, access control, and governance. Moving beyond traditional IAM, it unifies Privileged Access Management (PAM) foundations with zero standing privileges, eliminates standing local admin rights to prevent ransomware, and secures nonhuman machine and agentic identities at the scale AI demands across the cloud and data center.

- [Idira Overview](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira): Introduction to the next-generation identity security platform that enforces least-privilege access dynamically.
- [Human Identities](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human): Solutions for discovering, controlling, and governing the human workforce with layered, adaptive privilege controls.
- [Privileged Access Management](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human/privileged-access-management): Extends enterprise-grade privileged access controls to every human identity utilizing Just-in-Time (JIT) access.
- [Identity and Access Management](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human/identity-and-access-management): Secures your workforce and controls access to every resource with modern MFA and continuous verification.
- [Endpoint Privilege Manager](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human/endpoint-privilege-manager): Eliminates standing local admin rights across Windows, macOS, and Linux to prevent ransomware lateral movement.
- [Identity Governance](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human/identity-governance): Automates least-privileged access and entitlement reviews using AI profiles, cutting manual reviews by 75%.
- [Workforce Password Management](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human/workforce-password-management): Securely vaults, manages, and automatically rotates enterprise credentials in a centralized repository.
- [Vendor Privileged Access](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/human/vendor-privileged-access): Secures access for third-party vendors and contractors, eliminating VPN and bastion dependencies.
- [Machine Identities](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/machine): Secures nonhuman workload identities, API keys, and credentials at the scale AI demands across the cloud and data center.
- [Secrets Management](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/machine/secrets-management): SaaS or Self-Hosted enterprise vault and lifecycle automation for secrets, credentials, and workload access.
- [Unified Secrets Governance](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/machine/unified-secrets-governance): Discovers, governs, and syncs secrets across AWS, Azure, Google, and HashiCorp Vaults for centralized visibility.
- [Application Credentials Delivery](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/machine/application-credentials-delivery): Automatically removes embedded, hard-coded passwords from apps, scripts, and configurations at scale.
- [Agentic Identities](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/idira/agentic): Secures autonomous, self-reasoning AI agents by providing advanced visibility and controls for Model Context Protocol (MCP) data access.

## Unit 42 - Threat Intelligence & Services
> Unit 42 is an industry-leading threat intelligence, cyber risk management, and incident response organization helping enterprises proactively assess risk and respond to complex cyberattacks.

Bringing together over 500 world-renowned researchers and incident responders, Unit 42 helps organizations navigate the evolving threat landscape. Services include proactive Business Email Compromise (BEC) and Cyber Risk assessments, rapid Cloud Incident Response, digital forensics, and Managed Detection and Response (MDR). Unit 42 also specializes in defending against frontier AI threats and securing critical operational technology.

## Cloud Security (Prisma Cloud)
> The industry's comprehensive Cloud Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP) for the AI-driven, cloud-first world, securing applications from code to cloud.

Prisma Cloud and Cortex Cloud continuously build and deploy secure cloud infrastructure by embedding policy-as-code and fixing guidance directly into developer workflows. The platform integrates Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security, Software Composition Analysis (SCA) for open-source dependency scanning, Secrets Security, and Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM). It also delivers runtime defense-in-depth protection for virtual machines, Kubernetes, and serverless architectures.

- [Infrastructure as Code Security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/infrastructure-as-code-security): Continuously builds and deploys secure cloud infrastructure by embedding policy-as-code and fix guidance into developer workflows.
- [Software Composition Analysis](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/software-composition-analysis): Highly accurate, context-aware scanning of open source dependencies across languages and package managers.

- [Kubernetes and Container Security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/kubernetes-and-container-security): Defense-in-depth protection for containerized environments from code to cloud runtime.
- [API Security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/api-security): Discovery, posture management, and runtime protection for cloud APIs.
- [Serverless Security](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/serverless-security): Integrates security scanning for CI tools and repositories to flag serverless application risks early.
- [Government](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/cortex/cloud/government): Cloud security solutions utilizing FIPS 140-2 cryptographic modules, fully compliant with FedRAMP and GovRAMP/StateRAMP requirements.
